scope: Extend the three frozen native meridional eastward-component sections to 1995-2016 without selecting new geography from the multi-year results.
source_access: Existing contextual source audits remain unchanged. New numerical evidence is the explicitly acquired original NOAA PIFSC/ESR OSCAR2017.0 gridded vector archive; no new paper figure or observed current edge is extracted.
layer: Satellite-derived near-surface current product with nominal 15 m coordinate, not a direct instrument section or vertically resolved current.

identity_caveats.south-atlantic: Near-surface strongest eastward peak may reflect SAC, ACC, eddies or combined flow; intermediate-depth float-route identity does not transfer.
identity_caveats.south-pacific: STF geographic context is not a velocity axis; split bands, branches and eddies remain unresolved.
identity_caveats.south-indian: Near-surface peak cannot inherit historical upper-1000 m transport identity; ACC, northern subtropical front and eddy attribution remain unresolved.

remaining_gates: Resolve named-current, branch and eddy correspondence independently at each section and time.
Recover and validate flow-normal boundaries and effective resolution.
Separate model, sampling and boundary uncertainty before admitting physical dimension ranges.
